g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Half of rural Punjab's students cost households Rs 6,600 a year or less; the top tenth over Rs 30,000
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: students (ed_total > 0), Punjab rural, n = 9,173; 3 students outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 excluded. Weighted by hhweight.
